residual_risks: An older equivalent theorem phrased as maximal commutative idempotent submonoids or compatible interval-block partitions may exist.

Kiselman, A Semigroup of Operators in Convexity Theory (2002), a general closure-composition source: the original full text was not fully accessible; no strong matching theorem was identified from available evidence.
The exact pair sequence could occur in a specialist sequence table under a different combinatorial interpretation; a matching numerical sequence alone is not proof of prior theorem.

value.rationale: Classifies precisely all inclusion-maximal jointly commuting logical closure modalities on every finite Gödel chain, with a canonical structural tree model, per-family cardinality recurrence, exact ordered-pair distribution, and exponential rarity of commutation. These properties are mathematically natural under compositional modal semantics, not arbitrary finite slices or mere Catalan renaming.
